title: Made for the world / tapestries

location.extent: Complete published video; PNG is one poster frame

slide_intent: Show how disparate places can share a visual language because global breadth should feel connected rather than arbitrary.
strategic_value: Collaged landscapes becoming colorful textures can give Wise’s international premise a repeatable image vocabulary.
demonstration: The film layers landscapes beneath continent names, shifts into textured color fields with translated Made for the World lines and ends with the fast flag.
practical_value: Compare the recognizability of concrete locations with the flexibility of abstract textured fields.

content_islands.name: Place sequence
content_islands.spec: Layer geographical scenes beneath successive regional headlines.

content_islands.name: Tapestry sequence
content_islands.spec: Blend the scenes into colored textures behind translated messages.

content_islands.name: Closing identifier
content_islands.spec: Place the white fast flag over the final texture.

reference_purposes.Expression: The film layers landscapes beneath continent names, shifts into textured color fields with translated Made for the World lines and ends with the fast flag.
reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying Tapestries section explains that the assets draw on the world’s money and are intended to be recognizable and flexible.
